summary: Source search among pinned passages for bare root-reaching premises added in the 2026-11-07 batches; these were examined and left without a supports relation. STMT-CAUSED-BY-ANOTHER-IS-PARTICIPATED: ST I q.44 a.1 co./ad 1 (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q44-A1-PARTICIPATED-ESSE-CAUSE) and q.3 a.4 state only the converse (by participation, so caused by another); a converse is not support. Needs a pinned text that what is caused by another has the caused perfection by participation. STMT-PARTICIPATED-PERFECTION-IS-RECEIVED-IN-PARTICIPANT: De ente c.3-4 (AQUINAS-DE-ENTE-C3-RECEIVER-IN-POTENCY) goes from receiving to potency, not from participating to receiving; needs ST I q.75 a.5 ad 1 or In De Hebdomadibus lect. 2 ('participare est quasi partem capere'), neither pinned. STMT-HAVER-DEPENDS-ON-RECIPIENT: the pinned SCG II.80 n.13 is a counterinstance (the united soul's esse is received by the body but 'non dependens'); recorded as REL-SCG-II-80-UNITED-SOUL-ATTACKS-HAVER-DEPENDS-ON-RECIPIENT. STMT-UNLIMITED-HAVING-EXCEEDS-CAPACITY: ST I q.7 a.1 relates non-reception to infinity but has no degrees or capacity of a non-recipient z. STMT-CAUSED-IN-BEING-BY-ANOTHER-IS-CREATURE and STMT-TOTAL-CAUSE-CAUSES-MODES-OF-BEING: need ST I q.44 a.2 or q.45 a.1-2 (creation as production of the whole being), not pinned. STMT-INTELLECTUAL-EXERCISE-PRODUCES-AT: Aquinas calls understanding immanent action (the premise's own paraphrase); the inner word texts (ST I q.27 a.1, q.34 a.1) are not pinned, and q.25 a.1 defines active power as principle of acting on another, which bears against reading understanding as producing. STMT-INTELLECTUAL-EXERCISER-HAS-POWER: same gap, q.25 a.1 covers transient action only. STMT-FOUNDER-GUARANTEES-FOUNDED-AUTHORITY: the pinned Lumen Gentium III (VATICAN-II-LUMEN-GENTIUM-III, para. 25, 'sub assistentia Spiritus Sancti, ipsi in beato Petro promissa') bears on it, but no claim on para. 25 exists; a claim there (attribution deferred under the logic-first direction) would allow a supports relation. STMT-CONFIRMING-IS-ASSERTING: Dei Filius ch. 3 quotes Mk 16:20 ('sermonem confirmante, sequentibus signis'), which says the Lord confirmed the word by signs but not that confirming is asserting. STMT-CONSISTENT-TASK-REQUIRES-ONLY-POSSIBLE-PERFECTIONS: needs ST I q.25 a.3 (omnipotence and what implies no contradiction), not pinned. STMT-CREATURE-IN-POTENCY-TO-ITS-OPERATION: needs ST I q.54 a.1-3 (in no creature is action its substance or being), not pinned. STMT-MERELY-POSSIBLE-DOES-NOT-EXIST-AT: ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3 and q.3 a.4 give the converse direction only.
